quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, the driver of the vehicle on the left shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: Two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time.

obligation.description: The driver of the vehicle on the left yields right-of-way to the vehicle on the right when subsection 2 applies.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.
exceptions.description: Official control and opposing left-turn contexts limit subsection 2; subsection 4 requires separate source review.

timing.description: Use original body-history entry transitions and preserve sample brackets for both participants.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original entry brackets are measured; no legal time cutoff is supplied.
Original road classification and approach geometry require reviewed source records.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
judgment_calls_needed.note: The fixed yield sign requires original device review; subsection 4 condition is unestablished.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: approaching each other from opposite directions
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original approach trajectories and turning intent before applying the exception.
